cmd:
cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo
echo "--- git state"; git status --porcelain | head -5; git log --oneline -1
git pull --ff-only 2>&1 | tail -2
grep -c "fetch_ogimet_html" scripts/fetch_bufr_obs.py
timeout 50 python3 - <<'PY'
import sys, json, datetime, logging
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(message)s")
sys.path.insert(0,"scripts")
import fetch_bufr_obs as f
dt=datetime.datetime(2026,10,5,15)
html=f.fetch_ogimet_html(dt)
print("html:", None if html is None else len(html))
if html:
    o=f.parse_obs(html,dt)
    print({k:v for k,v in o.items() if v is not None and not k.endswith("_txt")})
    ref={r["dt"]:r for r in json.load(open("data/bufr_2026.json"))}.get("2026-10-05T15:00:00Z")
    if ref:
        d={k:(ref.get(k),o.get(k)) for k in o if ref.get(k)!=o.get(k) and not k.endswith("_txt")}
        print("diff vs existing Meteomanz record:", d)
    else:
        print("no existing 10-05 15Z record to compare")
PY
